title: Diving Into The Relations: Leveraging Semantic and Visual Structures For Video Moment Retrieval

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Diving Into The Relations: Leveraging Semantic and Visual Structures For Video Moment Retrieval Existing dominant approaches for video moment retrieval task are to learn semantic correlation between a given query and the video.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Finally, we adaptively aggregate and obtain the visual-semantic matching information through a multi-level fusion strategy to select the best matching moment proposal.

methods.name: Memory, Graph, or Structure Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: However, these methods rarely explore the fine-grained semantic structure and comprehensive visual structure, leading to insufficient utilization of textual and visual relations.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Specifically, a semantic role tree is built to reveal the fine-grained semantic information by generating hierarchical textual embeddings.
